brief:
Gaza's health ministry announced Sunday that the cumulative death toll from Israeli military operations since October 7, 2023 has reached 73,386 people, with an additional 174,250 wounded, according to Shehab Wire. The figures represent the latest official count from health authorities in the territory.

The ministry indicated that hospitals across Gaza have continued to receive casualties during the period covered by the updated toll, though a complete breakdown of admissions during specific hours was not immediately detailed in the announcement.
title: Gaza health ministry reports 73,386 dead in Israeli operations
